requests_credentials.instructions: Does `message.body` ask the recipient to provide a password or other login credential?

offers_unexpected_reward.instructions: Does `message.body` claim the recipient received an unexpected prize, payment, or reward?

creates_time_pressure.instructions: Does `message.subject` or `message.body` pressure the recipient to act quickly?

sender_identity_mismatch.instructions: Does the organization named in `message.sender.display_name` conflict with the domain in `message.sender.email`?

link_domain_mismatch.instructions: Does the domain in `message.links[0].url` conflict with the organization named in `message.sender.display_name`?

disguises_link_destination.instructions: Does `message.links[0].text` conceal or misrepresent the destination in `message.links[0].url`?
